default_dest_port.description: The default destination TCP port to use for traceroute probes.

source_port.description: The local TCP port to use for outgoing packets. Use 'auto' for kernel-assigned.

interface.description: The network interface to use for outgoing packets. Use 'auto' for default route.

probes.description: The number of probes to send to each hop.

timeout.description: The timeout in seconds to wait for a response for each probe.

max_ttl.description: The maximum TTL used in outgoing packets.

initial_ttl.description: The initial TTL used in the first outgoing packet.

tos.description: The IP TOS (type of service) to be used in outgoing packets.

packet_length.description: The total packet length to be used in outgoing packets.

flags.description: The TCP flag to set. 'S' for SYN, 'A' for ACK, 'E' for ECN SYN.
